capabilities_done: slice 1: Limits, STORE-only ZIP/ZIP64 writer, canonical bounded reader, canonical manifest, write/read_package, save_atomic, DESCRIPTOR, Observe mapping, package-consumer

slice 2 (1) blob table: ManifestEntry gains optional codec (raw default, never serialised) and raw_len; len = stored bytes, sha256_hex = identity of decoded bytes; v1 manifests stay valid and canonical; zstd only legal on assets with a declared raw_len <= max_entry_bytes

slice 2 (1) zstd decode via ruzstd =0.9.0 (std only; hash feature off): single frame, output capped at declared raw_len (expansion bomb stops at first over-read), window capped by new Limits.max_window_bytes (default 64 MiB), trailing bytes after the frame rejected, decoded SHA-256 verified

slice 2 (1) zstd encode: WriteOptions.asset_codec = Zstd uses ruzstd Fastest per blob, only when it shrinks (otherwise raw); deterministic; VERIFIED against libzstd 1.5.7 (Python 3.14 compression.zstd) on 7 inputs (empty, 1 byte, zeros, 1 MiB noise, 4 MiB pattern, f32 ramp, text) before enabling, plus end-to-end: package-consumer --zstd output unpacked and decoded by Python zipfile + libzstd, SHA-256 equals manifest identity

slice 2 (2) streaming: one strict implementation over a Source trait (slice or Read+Seek); preflight_stream, read_package_stream, PackageReader (open, manifest, entries, verify_all, read_asset by identity, into_opened); reads bounded to 1 MiB chunk / one central-directory record / manifest / entry being materialised; CD parsed record by record, never as one allocation

slice 2 (3) stale-temp sweep: StdFs now creates <temp>.owner marker (magic, pid, temp name) and holds an exclusive File::lock on it until replace/remove; sweep_stale_temps(target) deletes only the temp named by a valid, lock-free marker of another process (OS drops the lock when the owner dies, so no pid-liveness guessing and no pid-reuse hazard), never unmarked files, look-alikes, foreign-named markers, non-regular files, locked markers or this process's own saves; filesystems without locks get no marker and are never swept
package-consumer: --write [--assets DIR] [--zstd], --read (now streaming from File), --sweep TARGET

slice1: atomic_save_retains_last_good_and_cancel (child-process kill step moved into the sweep test)
tests.slice2_evidence: blob test: libzstd-produced frames (with and without content checksum) decode; length lies, trailing bytes, damaged frame, hash lie, 12.5 MiB RLE expansion bomb from ~400 bytes, window above limit, codec on non-asset, missing raw_len all rejected with typed codes. Stream test: identical verdict from slice and stream readers for every truncation and a bit flip at every offset of a package; 2.4 MB blob read with largest single request <= 1 MiB; hostile 4 GiB virtual source with 60000-entry EOCD dies at first record with reads <= 64 KiB. Sweep test: real child process exits at rename (dead owner swept, last-good untouched), second real child holds an open save (live owner skipped, files intact), dies without cleanup (then swept), decoys (unmarked temp, garbage marker, marker naming another file) never touched, own in-flight save never swept

decisions: Followed lead decision (in-house STORE-only ZIP64 + crc32fast) over the brief's zip crate; Limits has no max_ratio
No mimetype entry; first physical entry is manifest.json (enforced)
Entry names restricted to ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._-] components; non-ASCII names in foreign archives are rejected whole
Archive comment and trailing bytes are rejected
Blob table implemented as optional per-entry codec/raw_len fields in the existing manifest (not a separate table, not a container_version bump): keeps slice-1 packages valid and one canonical form
Re-saving an Opened package normalises compressed assets to whatever WriteOptions.asset_codec says (Raw default); identity and tile references are unaffected
StdFs is no longer a unit struct (holds owner locks): construct with StdFs::new() or Default
known_gaps: Oracle independence for the container: own writer vs own reader; mitigated by Python zipfile acceptance, an independent raw ZIP builder in tests, and (zstd) libzstd as independent encoder and decoder
ruzstd encoder verified at CompressionLevel::Fastest only (higher levels are marked unimplemented upstream); f32 tile payloads barely compress without a byte-shuffle prefilter (not built)
kill during the rename call itself not covered; sweep relies on File::lock (std 1.89+, toolchain 1.97.1); marker lifecycle on network filesystems with unreliable locks is unverified
ReadOnly folio inspections cannot be re-written (write takes a Snapshot); preview entry kind still only preserved opaque (skipped per instruction)
Opened materialises all assets (bounded by limits.max_total_bytes); use PackageReader::read_asset for lazy access
